name: KitchenFlow
world: Graphite paper, one dark volumetric form with an orange rim top right, embossed contour lines with rare orange threads. One plate for the whole reel; lines differ per scene.
rules: Only real KitchenFlow screens; never generated or redrawn UI, never invented numbers.
Demo data and demo OCR are labelled as demo on screen and in the voice.
The voice reads what is on screen; every on-screen word appears when it is spoken.
